lyrics:
[Spoken Word]

Power Pyramid Plumbing and Global Psyop Wrestling: the world as a rigged board game, played for laughs, never for gospel.

I read twenty-eight cards, one breath each, with a straight face.

Every family has one cousin with a corkboard and red string at Thanksgiving. Tonight, that cousin is me, with a beat.

If you already know Flexner, Gehlen and Gladio, sit up front. Everybody else: dance, I'll keep it short.

Cecil's Diamond Trust: soft-power imperialism, buying education to launder resources.

Cecil's kids grew up. Milner's Round Table: conquering with armies is messy, advisory boards profitable.

The Rothschild Ledger: nations borrow themselves into submission; war is high-yield investing.

Missed a payment? The Imperial "New Hitler" Cast: propaganda starter-pack whenever a state gets uppity.

The Federal Reserve Spider: private banking masquerading as government, financing endless wars.

Spider's new owl. BlackRock's Aladdin AI: doesn't predict the future, owns the companies that dictate it.

The Five Star Slush Fund: darkest rabbit hole of finance; secret shadow fund, off the books.

You get a collar. The CBDC Leash: your money comes with an expiration date and a moral score. How cute.

The Twenty-One-Year Gaslight: two wars, one imperial divorce, halftime show bankrupts peasants.

Losers had rockets. Operation Paperclip: unethical scholarship; "Never Again" became "maybe just once."

D.U.M.B.s: Maglev underground complexes, waiting for the surface world to destroy itself.

NATO "Peacekeepers": backing warlords, expanding proxy wars; the contractors wear Rolexes.

Paperclip's spy wing. Reinhard Gehlen, Spymaster: CIA's favorite ex-Nazi; lost one war, started another.

Gehlen orders fear. Operation Gladio: NATO's stay-behind armies keep people afraid, do the terrorizing.

USAID's "Infrastructure": agency for interference; building bridges straight to regime changes.

The Invention Secrecy Act: technologies mothballed; free energy is bad for the oil business.

Hoover's Dossier Diplomacy: FBI as personal gossip column; everyone in power owed him silence.

Hoover, plus sand. The Island Honeypot: debauchery as cover, cameras running; the client list is power.

No island needed. Algorithmic Deepfake Extortion: truth optional; AI weaponizes your face against you.

Roy Cohn's Legal Meatgrinder: maestro of intimidation, blackmail like a conductor's baton.

Rockefeller's Oil-to-Pills Pipeline: Flexner standardized medicine into petroleum-based profit.

The SSRI Nation: trace minerals out, addictive mood-flattening synthetics in. Genial.

Meet the dealers. The Pharma Mafia: criminal syndicate with PR; mob looks like scouts selling cookies.

Project Sunshine and Sea-Spray: radiation tests, sprayed bacteria, citizens as lab rats.

Gain-of-Function Roulette: supercharge a nasty virus with taxpayer money; what could go wrong?

The pig banker grins. The Scamdemic Board Game: locking everyone inside; greatest wealth redistribution.

The Event Two Oh One Simulation: tabletop pandemic; not a conspiracy, just excellent planning!

Turbo Cancer: cure causes cellular chaos; the industry doesn't panic, it patents treatments.

We fight over red string at Thanksgiving; the folks on the corkboard own the company that makes it.

Stay Fluffy, Folks!
lyrics2:
[Spoken Word]

Power Pyramid Plumbing and Global Psyop Wrestling, part two: the conspiracy business is kayfabe, a staged fight with real ticket sales.

I read these cards with a straight face so you can spot where the fear stops and the sales pitch starts.

My cousin Kevin swears the government reads his messages. He posts his breakfast, his gym times and his home address. Buddy, nobody has to spy on you. You're a livestream.

We tour the pyramid from Langley's binaural beats to Admiral Byrd's ice wall and a magenta saucer from nineteen thirty-three.

Operation Mockingbird: media infiltration; they don't write it, you just recite the lines.

AI Cognitive Warfare: the battlefield is your neocortex, and independent thought is suspicious.

Mass Formation Psychosis: fear, isolation, delusion; the new state religion is The Narrative.

One sheep blinked: The Twitter Files Drop: government quarantines wrongthink in the DMs; nothing changes.

Transhumanist Neuralink: the billionaire dream, escape death, turn peasantry into meat-routers.

Skip surgery: Smart Dust Panopticon: sensors in air and food report to whoever holds the DARPA contract.

Five G and Blue Light Grids: it irradiates you like beef, but hey, your TikToks load instantly!

Social Credit ESG Score: your compliance graded; your freedom is a revocable privilege.

Klaus the Sleep Paralysis Demon: own nothing, eat the bugs, thank the elite for serfdom.

Nowhere to go: Fifteen-Minute Climate Lockdowns: tyranny rebranded as climate emergency; open-air prison.

The WHO Treaty: unelected bureaucrats demand emergency powers for crises they helped fund.

Rebels? Subscribe: "Controlled" Opposition: influencer-to-psyop pipeline; they monetize fear, sell merch.

Older than Mockingbird: The Black Nobility: Roman powerhouses, God's oligarchs in Prada, pulling strings.

The Jesuit Deep State: accused backbone; five hundred years old, why not world domination?

Vatican Secret Archives: fifty miles of shelving, Galileo to dictators; God's filing cabinet.

Worn, not shelved: Nephilim Mitres: theorists claim the Pope's hat is a cozy for alien-hybrid skulls.

The Book of Enoch: too edgy for the Bible; a divine soap opera the church tried to bury.

The Akashic Records: Heaven's cloud storage, mystical Wikipedia before AI scraped your data.

Less heavenly storage: Suppressed Wizards Tesla and Schauberger: tech to free humanity, buried in vaults.

CIA Gateway Process: Langley greenlit binaural beats to map the cosmos, on your tax dollars.

Or go in person: Operation Highjump: Byrd found more than penguins; a treaty to never poke the ice wall.

The Magenta UFO: Mussolini recovered it, Vatican hid it, OSS stole it; the black-budget spark.

Geoengineering and The Dimming: notice grid patterns in the sky? You're a conspiracy theorist.

Same shrug at sea: Water-Air UAPs: anomalies laugh at physics; officially, weather balloons in the ocean.

I stay home: FrizzleBob's Freedom Bathrobe: we don't obey in underwear; we resist in bathrobes with tea.

Going out? Deep State Streetwear: black ops as streetwear; won't declassify history? We accessorize it.

Wear the joke too: The Satire Sanity Shield: when everything is fake, laughter is armor, not just coping.

The Analog Anarchist: real power is tactile, rowdy, unplugged from the algorithm. Stay free.

So yes, Kevin, someone is watching your livestream: the guy who sold you fear at midnight and a hoodie at breakfast.

Stay Fluffy, Folks!
